title: Vegan German Bisque
description: A rich and creamy German-inspired soup made with a variety of vegetables and a touch of nutmeg. This recipe is free from animal products, making it suitable for a vegan diet.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté the onion, garlic, and celery in vegan butter until softened.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Pour in enough water to cover the vegetables and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Return the soup to the heat and stir in vegan cream and nutmeg.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
